name: cursor-spending
description: Alpha: shows your Cursor spend and today's spend in the status bar, from your Cursor sign-in or Arc (Cursor Insights)

cursorSpending.refreshInterval.description: Refresh interval in minutes. Use the refresh command for an immediate update.

cursorSpending.statusBarCycleSeconds.description: Seconds between cycling status bar views (spend vs budget, then today $/day)

cursorSpending.lookupEmail.description: Optional (Arc only): your full Cursor account email. Arc's Cursor Insights skill looks up spend for this address only.

cursorSpending.useCursorSignIn.description: Fallback: build the cursor.com session cookie from your local Cursor sign-in, so no cookie needs to be pasted. The token is read locally and only sent to cursor.com.

cursorSpending.arcSkillId.description: Optional Cursor Insights skill ID override. Leave empty to auto-discover.

cursorSpending.warnPercent.description: Show a status-bar budget warning when spend reaches this percent of the limit.

cursorSpending.increaseLimitUrl.description: HTTPS link opened from the budget warning (request a Cursor spend limit increase). Defaults to the Trimble Cloud Ops service desk form.

cursorSpending.showTeamSpend.description: Include team/org spend (pooled or on-demand) in the status-bar tooltip. Off by default; most users only need their individual spend.

cursorSpending.debugFakeLimitUsd.description: Debug only: pretend this dollar amount is your individual LIMIT (not a percent). 0 = real limit. With ~$1,260 spend: 1300 ≈ yellow (~97%), 1000 = red (>100%).

colors.description: Status bar text color when spend is showing normally (below the budget warning threshold).

commands.title: Cursor Spending: Set up Arc API key
Cursor Spending: Remove Arc API key

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run build:icon && npm run compile
scripts.package: npm run build:icon && npm run compile && npx vsce package
